findings.finding: The conversational V1 interpreter exposes a closed metric/action vocabulary and explicitly directs unsupported analyses to unavailability. It is not the SQL investigator.

Direct Ask removes the historical SKU/date seal but still constructs a manual catalog from earlier sealed projections. Product exposes only item_code, item_name, inventory_uom_id. Invoice customer and product business classification are absent from the model catalog.
The SQL investigator's authorization is supervised-local-uid plus sealed catalog equality, not authenticated Team360 RBAC. It must not be relabeled Presidencia or FULL_ACCESS.

Existing conversational authorization already calls PermissionConsoleRepository.list_effective_permissions and verifies identity/channel/policy scope. Its whole_workspace_scope_verified flag rejects unsupported partial scopes; it is not a row policy compiler.

FoundationReader offers pinned sales, credit memo, inventory and receivables relations, reference files and sealed commercial semantics. Restricted discovery is therefore not equivalent to absence of all those sources. Publication membership and schemas still require a fresh read-only inspection.

The validator recursively checks table permissions through CTEs and derived tables, denies physical references, emits new SQL and rejects unknown AST. Column availability is currently the sealed projection, not a live column entitlement resolver. Scalar subqueries, windows, casts and other constructs are outside its current subset.

Each manual logical table has max_rows=1000000 while the default join-pair budget is 10000. The product-of-bounds calculation can reject otherwise useful joins before execution. Keep resource controls; do not globally increase the budget to mask this limitation.

Existing scoped FULL_ACCESS expands enabled workspace capability permissions in its module namespace. It does not provide a distinct, independently accredited business-data discovery policy. Do not grant this technical profile to Presidencia as a shortcut.

Historical internal-exception evidence already reports the supplied August raw-material line amount on a partial BS population, but explicitly does not accredit the excluded line as USD. This is not a fresh monthly/customer reconciliation and cannot establish how free Pi obtained its result.
